question: Chitti Babu is associated with which musical instrument?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Veena**__.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chitti Babu** was a classical musician from India, and one of the greatest **Veena **artistes, in the Carnatic Music genre of South India, who became a legend in his own lifetime.
